# BuzzDBBook Fixture

This fixture contains `buzzdb-book.tokensmith.md`, a TokenSmith-marked Markdown version of the BuzzDB book used by the benchmark and context-routing tests.

The fixture is intentionally stored as Markdown with `tokensmith:chunk` markers so tests can use stable chunk IDs instead of generated row IDs. The source BuzzDB project is public and Apache-2.0 licensed:

https://github.com/jarulraj/buzzdb/
